$comment: Storybook art for the Banyan video, generated once with Inspyry (flat vector SVG) by `pnpm --filter @banyan/video art`. One subject per asset (Inspyry does not do full scenes); the composition lays them out and animates them. Keep every asset on the shared style + palette so the scene looks like one book. Sky (sun, moon, stars, clouds), diyas and the temple bell are drawn in code in ArtScene.tsx so their faces stay consistent. src/art/banyan.svg has a hand-added scalloped clipPath that rounds the generated canopy's cut-off corner; re-add it if you regenerate.

defaults.avoid: text, letters, words, background scenery, frame, border, shadow on the ground
